title: Stick2yourDeen (Stickers)
desc: "JI wanted to hand out gifts to children during Ramadan and on Eid. The issue was that most stickers she found did not reflect her identity as a Muslimah, and also did not appeal to the youth. “We wanted something this generation would actually use,” JI reflected, and she got to work. She always had a passion for graphic design, and so she and her sister designed some stickers together. Unexpectedly, the community began to roar with questions: “Where can I buy more?” “Do you sell these?” Originally, JI refused and wanted to continue to hand out the stickers for free. However, ultimately she realised that if she turned her passion into a business, she would be able to invest more time, spread Islamic reminders further, and reach more Muslims."
